Snake Game

The classic snake game on a 20×20 canvas — keyboard and touch controls, speeding up as you eat.

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start.
  2. Steer with arrow keys / WASD or the on-screen pad.
  3. Eat the red food to grow and score 10 points.
  4. Avoid walls and your own tail — then beat your best.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I play on my phone?

Yes — use the arrow keys or WASD. On mobile, tap the on-screen direction pad.

Does it get faster?

It starts at a relaxed pace and gets 4ms faster per food, down to a minimum step time — so it keeps getting harder.

Is my best score saved?

Yes, in your browser's local storage. Nothing is sent anywhere.
